company.name: PlantShop.me
company.shortDescription: Plantshop.me is an e-commerce platform that specializes in selling live plants and gardening products online.
company.description: Plantshop.me is an e-commerce platform based in the United Arab Emirates that specialises in selling live plants and gardening products online. The website allows customers to easily browse and purchase a wide range of indoor and outdoor plants along with gardening tools, seeds, fertilisers, pots, and plant care accessories.

productsAndServices.description: PlantShop.me offers a variety of plants suitable for indoor and outdoor environments, including species like Ponytail Dwarf Palm, Variegated Afra Bonsai, and Areca Palm.
productsAndServices.name: Indoor and Outdoor Plants

productsAndServices.description: The marketplace provides tools necessary for gardening, such as gardening gloves, plant support clips, and trowels.
productsAndServices.name: Gardening Tools

productsAndServices.description: Available products include fertilizers, insecticides, and soil conditioners, with options like Folikraft Magic Fertilizer and Organic Leaf Shine Spray.
productsAndServices.name: Plant Care Products

productsAndServices.description: Specialty potting soils and mixes are available, including Speciality Potting Soil, Aroid Soil Mix, and Organic Coconut Shell Chips.
productsAndServices.name: Potting Soils and Mixes

productsAndServices.description: Decorative items for plant display include Vintage Terracotta Pot, Geo Concrete Mini Pot, and various Cubo designs.
productsAndServices.name: Decorative Pots and Planters

productsAndServices.description: Terrariums in different shapes and sizes, such as Round Sandy and Square Sandy, are offered for creating miniature landscapes.
productsAndServices.name: Terrariums
